messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync  propose GA-minimum observability surface: dashboards (ops + cost + errors), targeted tracing hooks for latency tails, and grouped error analytics. Agree?
Sam (Eng): Agree. Do targeted hooks + sampling. Concern: perf impact at high QPS.
Jordan (SRE): Targeted + async export. Add circuit-breaker for exporter. Retention proposal: traces 14d, aggregates 90d.
Lee (Data): Route-level cost % first; per-tenant card as estimated with sampling. Expect ~5-10% variance.
Ruth (CS): Sales needs per-tenant card + top error groups. CSV export please.
Maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria:
- Ops dashboard: p50/p95/p99 for top routes
- Cost card: route % + per-tenant estimated card in Console
- Tracing: instrument top 5 endpoints with targeted spans + 100% on errors
- Error analytics: group by exception and surface top traces
- Perf gate: <=5% CPU increase in tests
Sam (Eng): I'll own tracing spike + perf run (2 sprints).
Jordan (SRE): I'll run perf tests and define rollback threshold.
Lee (Data): I'll ship cost-card prototype this sprint. Tooltip will note accuracy.
Ruth (CS): I'll prepare customer one-pager and sample CSV.
Sam (Eng): Need infra quota for async exporter topic  filing ticket.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: obs-instrumentation/spike -> staging at 2025-04-11T18:00Z :rocket:
Maya (PM): Owners assigned. Next sync Thu 09:00. Thanks.
